metrics.name: active_members
metrics.description: Distinct members with a membership covering the date. Ask for one day, usually the last day of a period. The end date counts as the member's last day.

metrics.name: cancellations
metrics.description: Plan periods that ended with status cancelled. A plan change is not a cancellation.

metrics.name: charge_attempts
metrics.description: All monthly charge attempts, paid or failed.

metrics.name: churn_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Cancellations per member-month, with each member-day counted in the period it happened. Use this for churn by month or year.

metrics.name: failed_payment_rate
metrics.description: Share of charge attempts that failed.

metrics.name: member_months
metrics.description: Member-days divided by 30. The denominator for monthly rates.

metrics.name: member_months_by_day
metrics.description: Member-days divided by 30, counted on the day they happened. Use this for monthly or yearly rates.

metrics.name: monthly_churn_rate
metrics.description: Cancellations per member-month over the whole period. Use it to compare groups such as plans, gyms or genders. Do not group it by month or year: use churn_rate_over_time for churn over time.

metrics.name: visits
metrics.description: Gym visits (check-ins). Compare groups with visits_per_member_month, not raw visits.

metrics.name: visits_per_member_month
metrics.description: Visits per member-month. The fair way to compare how often members visit across plans or gyms.

dimensions.name: metric_time__day
dimensions.description: The metric's date, by day. Use for a single date such as active members on Dec 31, 2025.

dimensions.name: payment__plan_name
dimensions.description: The plan the member was charged for.

dimensions.name: payment__status
dimensions.description: paid or failed. Failed charges are not retried.

dimensions.name: check_in__check_in_hour
dimensions.description: Hour of the visit, from 5 (5am) to 22 (10pm).

dimensions.name: check_in__plan_name
dimensions.description: The plan held on the visit date.

dimensions.name: member_day__plan_name
dimensions.description: The plan held on this day.

dimensions.name: membership__plan_name
dimensions.description: The plan held during this period: Basic, Standard or Premium.

dimensions.name: membership__status
dimensions.description: How the period ended: active (still running), changed (plan change) or cancelled.

dimensions.name: membership__cancel_reason
dimensions.description: The member's stated reason, for cancelled periods only.

dimensions.name: location__location_name
dimensions.description: Gym name, for example Jacksonville - Southside or Ocala.

dimensions.name: member__current_status
dimensions.description: active if the latest membership row is still running, churned if it was cancelled.

dimensions.name: member__current_plan
dimensions.description: The plan on the member's latest membership row.
